newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria 1-, 4-wk discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell at Tuesday's auctions of Bulgarian finance ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bills, central bank figures showed.
The average yields to maturity on the two issues were 1.07 and 5.04 percent, respectively, down from 1.20 and 5.19 percent at Monday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 76.634 billion lev worth of paper. The one-week issue was heavily oversubscribed and the four-week undersubscribed.
The ministry approved bids for a total of 47.411 billion levs of paper.
The issues were offered with par values of 12 billion levs and 45 billion levs, respectively, and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
